text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Oka Sho. The Mejiro 
family's "Grandmother" comes to inspect 
Mejiro Ramonu's condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first Classic victory for the Mejiro 
family. And the first-ever Triple Tiara 
achievement. The Trainer feels the weight 
of those expectations as pure pressure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Ramonu paid no mind to the 
pressure. She explained that she could 
stay strong because she took pride in 
loving racing more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her childhood, she couldn't run due to 
issues with her legs. Driven by that 
frustration and a deep love for racing, 
she fought relentlessly against her 
imperfections, to the point of bleeding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gaining a renewed understanding of the 
reason behind her strength, the Trainer, 
as a fellow lover of racing, vowed in 
their heart to become stronger as well.
